+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { once } from 'node:events'
+import fs from 'node:fs/promises'
+import path from 'node:path'
+import {
+  createMemoryEnvironment,
+  getFrameworkById,
+  getFrameworks,
+  registerFramework,
+} from '@tanstack/create'
+import { DevWatchManager } from '../../src/dev-watch.ts'
+
+const root = process.argv[2]
+assert.ok(root)
+const watchPath = path.join(root, 'framework')
+const targetDir = path.join(root, 'target')
+await fs.mkdir(path.join(watchPath, 'project', 'base'), { recursive: true })
+await fs.mkdir(targetDir)
+const source = path.join(watchPath, 'project', 'base', 'marker.txt')
+await fs.writeFile(
+  path.join(watchPath, 'project', 'base', 'package.json'),
+  '{}',
+)
+await fs.writeFile(source, 'initial')
+registerFramework({
+  id: 'watch-refresh',
+  name: 'Watch refresh',
+  description: 'Repeated edit fixture',
+  version: '1.0.0',
+  base: {},
+  addOns: [],
+  basePackageJSON: {},
+  optionalPackages: {},
+  supportedModes: {
+    'file-router': {
+      displayName: 'File router',
+      description: '',
+      forceTypescript: true,
+    },
+  },
+})
+const framework = getFrameworkById('watch-refresh')
+const { environment } = createMemoryEnvironment()
+const cliOptions = {
+  projectName: 'watch-refresh',
+  targetDir,
+  framework,
+  mode: 'file-router',
+  typescript: true,
+  tailwind: false,
+  packageManager: 'npm',
+  git: false,
+  install: true,
+  intent: false,
+  chosenAddOns: [],
+  addOnOptions: {},
+}
+const manager = new DevWatchManager({
+  watchPath,
+  targetDir,
+  framework,
+  cliOptions,
+  packageManager: 'npm',
+  environment,
+})
+try {
+  await manager.start()
+  // Wait for the underlying watcher before changing the fixture.
+  await once(manager.watcher, 'ready')
+  for (const value of ['first edit', 'second edit']) {
+    await fs.writeFile(source, value)
+    const deadline = Date.now() + 8000
+    let content
+    do {
+      content = await fs
+        .readFile(path.join(targetDir, 'marker.txt'), 'utf8')
+        .catch(() => undefined)
+      if (content === value) break
+      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50))
+    } while (Date.now() < deadline)
+    assert.equal(content, value)
+  }
+  assert.equal(
+    getFrameworks().filter((item) => item.id === 'watch-refresh-updated')
+      .length,
+    1,
+  )
+  console.log('WATCH_REFRESH_VERIFIED')
+} catch (error) {
+  console.error(error)
+} finally {
+  // DevWatch shutdown exits the child, so the parent checks the success marker.
+  await manager.stop()
+}

+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { createApp as createNodeApp } from '../src/create-app.js'
+import { createApp as createEdgeApp } from '../src/edge-create-app.js'
+import { createMemoryEnvironment } from '../src/edge-environment.js'
+import type { AddOn, Framework, Options } from '../src/types.js'
+
+const commandAddOn: AddOn = {
+  id: 'command-approval',
+  name: 'Command approval',
+  description: 'Version-aware command fixture',
+  type: 'add-on',
+  phase: 'add-on',
+  modes: ['file-router'],
+  command: {
+    command: 'npx',
+    args: ['storybook', 'init'],
+    allowBuilds: ['esbuild'],
+  },
+  getFiles: async () => [],
+  getFileContents: async () => '',
+  getDeletedFiles: async () => [],
+}
+
+const framework: Framework = {
+  id: 'version-fixture',
+  name: 'Version fixture',
+  description: 'Version fixture',
+  version: '1.0.0',
+  basePackageJSON: {},
+  optionalPackages: {},
+  supportedModes: {
+    'file-router': {
+      displayName: 'File router',
+      description: '',
+      forceTypescript: true,
+    },
+  },
+  getFiles: async () => [],
+  getFileContents: async () => '',
+  getDeletedFiles: async () => [],
+  getAddOns: () => [commandAddOn],
+}
+
+const options: Options = {
+  projectName: 'version-fixture',
+  targetDir: '/app',
+  framework,
+  mode: 'file-router',
+  typescript: true,
+  tailwind: false,
+  packageManager: 'pnpm',
+  git: false,
+  install: false,
+  intent: false,
+  chosenAddOns: [commandAddOn],
+  addOnOptions: {},
+}
+
+for (const [runtime, createApp] of Object.entries({
+  Node: createNodeApp,

+import {
+  mkdirSync,
+  mkdtempSync,
+  readdirSync,
+  readFileSync,
+  rmSync,
+  statSync,
+  writeFileSync,
+} from 'node:fs'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import { join, relative } from 'node:path'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+
+const frameworksDir = fileURLToPath(
+  new URL('../src/frameworks', import.meta.url),
+)
+
+// Claude 3 model IDs have been retired by Anthropic, so a template that still
+// hard-codes one generates a project whose AI chat fails at the first request.
+const RETIRED_CLAUDE_MODEL = /claude-3(?:-5|-7)?-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku)/
+
+function listFiles(dir: string): Array<string> {
+  return readdirSync(dir).flatMap((entry) => {
+    if (entry === 'node_modules') return []
+    const full = join(dir, entry)
+    return statSync(full).isDirectory() ? listFiles(full) : [full]
+  })
+}
+
+function findRetiredModelFiles(root: string): Array<string> {
+  return listFiles(root)
+    .filter((file) => /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md|ejs)$/.test(file))
+    .filter((file) => RETIRED_CLAUDE_MODEL.test(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')))
+    .map((file) => relative(root, file))
+}
+
+describe('framework templates', () => {
+  it('do not reference retired Claude model IDs', () => {
+    expect(findRetiredModelFiles(frameworksDir)).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  it('ignores installed dependencies while checking authored templates', () => {
+    const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'tanstack-model-scan-'))
+    try {
+      const vendor = join(root, 'node_modules', 'sdk')
+      const authored = join(root, 'src', 'model.ts')
+      mkdirSync(vendor, { recursive: true })
+      mkdirSync(join(root, 'src'))
+      const retired = "export type Model = 'claude-3-opus-20240229'"
+      writeFileSync(join(vendor, 'index.d.ts'), retired)
+      writeFileSync(authored, retired)
+      expect(findRetiredModelFiles(root)).toEqual([join('src', 'model.ts')])
+      writeFileSync(authored, "export const model = 'claude-haiku-4-5'")
+      expect(findRetiredModelFiles(root)).toEqual([])
+    } finally {
+      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
+    }
+  })
+})
